prompt: 幫城市 as-twn-taipei（變體 orig）跑「LLM 網絡循環」——與該泳道上的程式網絡循環（移點-移線-移枝-併格）並存，另餵 Frame（compact=llm-network-loop）。起點＝系統已清掉舊循環檔後的 LLM 直線化結果（該鏈檔的 align 子物件，取值一律 alignOf(doc)）；缺對齊先停、不要自己亂起點。反覆 export → 分析 → apply 迭代到收斂（上限 10 輪）；每輪 moves.json 含 model 與 note，第一輪附 prompt。目標：在硬規則內提高 H/V、壓縮空欄空列、縮短路線。完成後只輸出 HV／格網尺寸前後與一句總結。

transcript.note: Round 1 — build a shared column and close a dangling diagonal. Vertices 44, 40, 23, 12, 38, 13, 2, 18, 20, 45 and 33 are each pinned on both axes by two or more existing H/V segments, so the only movable hubs are 36, 58 and the degree-2 terminus 7. Moved 36 (30,30)->(25,30) and 58 (33,34)->(25,34), which keeps 36-44 and 58-24 horizontal (rows unchanged) while stacking 36, 58 and 16 on column 25 — that turns both 36-58 and 58-16 into verticals. It trades away the 45-degree 45-36, 36-23 and 44-58, which is the right trade because the score is lexicographic on H/V first and 45-degree only as a tie-break. Moved terminus 7 (1,46)->(1,42) rather than moving 11: it keeps 7-48 vertical on column 1, turns 11-7 into a horizontal that now runs collinear with 15-11 as one straight east-west spine on row 42, and it vacates row 46 so compaction can drop that band. Winding order re-checked by atan2 at 36, 58 and 16 — unchanged in all three; 7 and 11 are degree 2 and exempt.
transcript.noteZh: 第 1 輪——做出一條共用直行並收掉一條懸空的斜段。頂點 44、40、23、12、38、13、2、18、20、45、33 每一個都被兩條以上既有 H/V 段在兩軸上釘死，真正可動的樞紐只有 36、58 與度數 2 的端點站 7。把 36 從 (30,30) 移到 (25,30)、58 從 (33,34) 移到 (25,34)：兩者的列都沒變，所以 36-44 與 58-24 兩條水平段原封保住，而 36、58、16 疊到同一欄 25，使 36-58 與 58-16 雙雙變成垂直段。代價是放掉 45-36、36-23、44-58 三條 45 度；這個交換是划算的，因為評分是先比 H/V、45 度只當同分時的決勝條件。端點站 7 從 (1,46) 移到 (1,42)（而不是改動 11）：這樣 7-48 仍然是欄 1 上的垂直段，11-7 變成水平段並與 15-11 共線成為列 42 上一條筆直的東西向主軸，同時空出列 46 讓壓縮把那一條帶拿掉。已用 atan2 逐一複查 36、58、16 的環繞序，三者皆未改變；7 與 11 度數為 2，不在檢查範圍。

transcript.note: Round 2 — two rigid-group translations, because after round 1 every endpoint of every remaining unaligned segment is pinned on both axes by two or more H/V segments, so no single-vertex move can gain anything. (a) Slid the whole row-12 group 40, 17, 34, 55 down one row to row 13 as a rigid unit: all of its internal H/V survives (17-34, 34-55 stay horizontal on the new row; 40-10, 17-22, 17-30, 55-32 stay vertical because their columns are untouched), and 44-40 closes into a horizontal on row 13 next to 36-44. It vacates row 12 for compaction. (b) Slid the column-15 pair 38, 12 three columns east to column 18, where 13 already sits: 38-12 stays vertical, 38-18, 23-12 and 22-12 stay horizontal because the rows are untouched, and 13-38 closes into a vertical — column 18 now reads as one clean north-south trunk 21-6-13-38-12 with no station swallowed between 13 and 38. Winding order re-checked by atan2 at every moved vertex and at each of their unmoved neighbours 10, 22, 30, 12, 44, 23, 18, 40 — unchanged everywhere; 34, 55 and 32 are degree 2 and exempt. Left alone as structurally impossible: 38-23, 36-23, 45-36, 44-58, 23-20, 16-33 and 2-18, each of which is the third side of a triangle whose other two sides are already H/V, or would swallow station 37 if forced vertical.

transcript.note: Round 3 — one H/V gain plus a compaction sweep. (a) H/V: vertex 12 is the only vertex left with a free axis (its row is pinned at 10 by 22-12 and 23-12, its column by nothing but the two unaligned segments), so I moved it 15->17 on row 10. Column 17 is where 40 sits, which upgrades 40-12 from 45-degree to a true vertical — the better of the two choices, since sending 12 to column 18 would have closed 38-12 instead but destroyed the 45-degree rather than promoting it. It also vacates column 15. (b) Compaction: no band is empty, so the grid can only shrink if I evacuate the bands that a single degree-1 or degree-2 vertex is holding open, parking each one on a band that is already occupied. Columns: 5 -> col 17 (frees 16), 11 -> col 6 (frees 1), 34 and 41 -> col 22 (frees 20 and 21), 46 -> col 24 (frees 23). Rows: 21 -> row 0 (frees 1), 37 -> row 4 (frees 5), 0 -> row 7 (frees 6), 48 -> row 11 (frees 9), 42 -> row 15 (frees 16), 19 -> row 19 (frees 18), 56 -> row 17 and 57 -> row 19 (frees 20 and 21; the column-4 chain 56-57-49-52 needs four distinct rows, so two of them are parked on rows 17 and 19 which already carry stations, and that is the most this chain can give up). Every one of these keeps its own H/V segment intact because only the free axis moves, and each destination was checked against the horizontal or vertical segment already running along that band so no station is swallowed. All fourteen movers are degree 1 or 2 except 12, whose winding order I re-checked by atan2 along with its neighbours 40, 22, 23 and 38 — unchanged.
